reply.text: {"route": "answer", "say": "Break it into chunks so it's not one long grind. Easy pace until you're well warmed up, then a middle stretch where you settle in and can hold a steady rhythm, then the last couple miles you just grind out on feel. Some people throw in a few surges or pick-up miles late to teach the legs to run tired. What matters most is finishing relaxed, not fast."}
